question: Which of the following is a dance form in Mizoram participated exclusively by 'village guests'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khuallam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• During a special occasion called Khuangchawi, the Khuallam dance is performed by the local performers of Mizoram.
 
 
• **The term Khuallam means dance of guests.**
 
• people invited to view the performance are often seen dancing while coming inside the respective venue.
 
 
 
• Puandum is the traditional costume which is worn by the **Khuallam dancers.**
 
• Handwoven Mizo cloth known as Puandum is wrapped over the shoulders and the dance is performed by swaying the cloth.
